questionText: does legion trigger if the card was countered?
question: Does the [Legion] trigger fire if the card that would have satisfied Legion was countered?
assumptions: RiftJudge p1561 — abstract question about Legion + countering. The bridge's rules-demo legion topic explains: a played card increments `cardsPlayedThisTurn[controller]` at PLAY TIME (rule 555); even if the spell body is later countered (FAQ on 555.3), the play already happened — so subsequent Legion triggers DO see it. Counterspell stops the BODY of the spell, not the fact of the play.
